verdict.rationale: Authy's features page documents a backup feature meant for when you lose your phone. The backup is encrypted and only decrypted with your password, and new devices are added via SMS, voice or existing-device approval, so tokens can be restored on a replacement phone. Community comments partly corroborate this, describing the backup password and recovery via a replacement SIM. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party step-by-step recovery documentation (beyond feature-page blurbs), and hands-on reports confirming tokens actually restored on a new device after loss.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Use our backup feature incase you lose your phone. We encrypt your data, and only decrypt on the devices using a password only you know.
Add new devices with SMS, voice or existing device approval.
View information, rename, and remove lost/stolen devices.
